# Core feature specimen

This chapter begins the cross-format test corpus. It includes common technical
elements and will grow as each roadmap capability is evaluated.
{{< alk-term central-processing-unit form=first case=sentence >}} designs provide
a concrete counterpoint to Turing's abstract model of computation, a fitting
early citation [@turing1936].

## Heading hierarchy {#sec-heading-hierarchy}

Chapters use level-one headings. Ordinary divisions use level two and appear in
the book contents with chapter-based numbers.

### Numbered subsection with a descriptive title {#sec-numbered-subsection}

Level-three headings remain numbered and listed because they often carry useful
technical structure such as phases, subsystems, or derivation stages.

#### Detail heading excluded from numbering and contents

Level-four headings provide local structure without extending decimal numbers
or crowding the contents. Levels five and six are reserved for future semantic
components rather than used as a substitute for reorganizing a chapter.

The reference language comes from the active locale and uses unabbreviated
labels. For example, @sec-heading-hierarchy and @sec-numbered-subsection are
section references; @fig-half-adder, @tbl-half-adder, @eq-ohms-law, and
@lst-half-adder exercise the figure, table, equation, and listing labels.

## Links, emphasis, and notes

Alkahest is developed as a collection of plain-text sources. The
[Quarto website](https://quarto.org/) is an external link, while
@sec-equations is an internal cross-reference. This sentence has a footnote
that must remain navigable in reflowable output.^[A useful footnote should not
depend on the geometry of a printed page.]

## Paragraph rhythm

The first paragraph after a heading begins flush left so the structural break
does not need a second visual cue. Its lines establish the normal body rhythm
against which headings, lists, equations, figures, and tables can be judged.

Following paragraphs use a first-line indent instead of additional vertical
space. This conventional book treatment keeps related prose together and
avoids turning a page of short technical paragraphs into disconnected blocks.

A third consecutive paragraph makes accidental one-off behavior visible. The
PDF backends should agree on the treatment even when their exact line breaks
differ, while HTML and EPUB retain their reflowable medium-appropriate styles.
The selected text faces must also provide *real italics*, **real bold**, and
***bold italic*** alongside punctuation such as “curly quotes,” en dashes,
em dashes, and ellipses… without synthetic styling or fallback.

## Equations {#sec-equations}

Inline mathematics such as $V = I R$ should share a baseline with prose. The
same relationship can be numbered for later reference:

$$
V = I R
$$ {#eq-ohms-law}

@eq-ohms-law must be legible in print, responsive on the web, and
represented accessibly where the output permits it.

## Code listings

The half-adder in @lst-half-adder tests syntax highlighting, a caption, and a
cross-reference.

```{#lst-half-adder .verilog lst-cap="A combinational half-adder"}
module half_adder(
  input  logic a,
  input  logic b,
  output logic sum,
  output logic carry
);
  assign sum   = a ^ b;
  assign carry = a & b;
endmodule
```

Long-line policy must be tested explicitly rather than discovered during final
layout:

```text
0123456789 0123456789 0123456789 0123456789 0123456789 0123456789 0123456789 0123456789
```

The code face must keep commonly confused characters distinct:
`0 O 1 l I | { [ ( < - + = > ) ] }`.

## Diagrams and figures

@fig-half-adder is a text-authored diagram. Later specimens will add proper
logic symbols, timing diagrams, electrical schematics, plots, and chemical
structures.

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-half-adder
%%| fig-cap: "The information flow through a half-adder."
flowchart LR
  A[Input A] --> XOR[XOR]
  B[Input B] --> XOR
  A --> AND[AND]
  B --> AND
  XOR --> S[Sum]
  AND --> C[Carry]
```

## Book divisions

The title, publication-data, and dedication treatments draw from one shared
metadata record. This chapter belongs to a named part, and
@sec-page-system-checklist, @sec-format-behavior, and @sec-language-and-script
exercise three independently addressable appendices.

## Deliberately pending specimens

The following features require a tool choice or design decision and are tracked
in the roadmap rather than represented by a misleading placeholder:

- chemical formulae, reactions, and 2D molecular structures;
- publication-quality electrical circuits and logic diagrams;
- data-driven graphs with accessible descriptions;
- index generation.
